title: Textile passport (textile@2), restricted payload
description: textile@2: the restricted tiers held off chain, encrypted, and committed by field 11. JSON Schema validity is one check; obligation under a condition (needs-review), units, provenance and legal applicability are separate checks.

chemicalCompliance.title: Chemical compliance evidence
chemicalCompliance.description: recommended; REACH Art. 33 read with ESPR Annex III(d): compliance documentation

separability.title: What comes apart
separability.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(h) and (i): ease of disassembly, for reuse and recycling

eprRegistration.title: Producer responsibility registration
eprRegistration.description: recommended; Waste Framework Directive textile EPR: the producer register number

dueDiligence.title: Due diligence report
dueDiligence.description: recommended; Dir. (EU) 2024/1760 corporate sustainability due diligence, where in scope

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: optional; Nothing requires this. It is the owner tier the selective-disclosure demo turns on.

purchase.title: Purchased
purchase.description: optional; Nothing requires this. It is what makes the record theirs.

personalisation.title: Alterations and fit
personalisation.description: optional; Nothing requires this. An altered garment is a different garment to its owner.

warrantyRegistration.title: Guarantee registration
warrantyRegistration.description: optional; Nothing requires this. It saves the owner keeping a receipt.
